title: Most Expensive Product
prompt: A catalog page wants to feature the highest priced product. Write a function that returns the product name with the largest price. If the list is empty, return an empty string.

explanation.beginner:
Example: mostExpensiveProduct([{"name":"Pen","price":2},{"name":"Bag","price":30},{"name":"Mug","price":12}]) produces "Bag". The result must follow this precise rule: A catalog page wants to feature the highest priced product. Write a function that returns the product name with the largest price. If the list is empty, return an empty string. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “returns empty for no products”: input [[]] produces "". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.
